name: Awl & Gusset
pitch: Set a bag's dimensions and get the cut pieces, the stitch-hole plan, the hardware and the build order.
problem: A hand-drafted bag pattern has to be redrawn for every size.

features.text: Every seam fits a whole number of holes, and both sides get the same count.
details: So a gusset can't creep against its panel
Holes numbered every ten, so you can check as you go
Tiled A4 sheets with alignment crosses and a ruler

details: Leather, thread length and holes to prick, all totalled
